'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Palestinian political violence]]
***A [[Palestine|Palestinian]] assailant stabs two [[Israelis|Israeli]] civilians in [[Tzova]], [[Jerusalem District]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/two-wounded-one-seriously-in-suspected-terror-stabbing-at-hotel-west-of-jerusalem/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**[[Nepal Police|Nepali police]] announce that nine prisoners have been killed and 12,500 others are at large after a series of [[Prison escape|jailbreaks]] across [[Nepal]] amid the ongoing protests. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/12/nepal-protest-death-toll-reaches-51-as-12500-prisoners-remain-on-the-run (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Haitian conflict (2020–present)|Haitian conflict]]
**At least 42 people are killed by armed gangs, including the [[Haitian conflict (2020–present)#Formation of the Viv Ansanm|Viv Ansamn]], in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-killed-massacre-arcahaie-labodrie-gangs-a32c5a0765921b0f443f4ccf2efd8062 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**At least 18 people, mostly students, are killed in a [[Tatmadaw]] airstrike on two schools in [[Kyauktaw Township]] in [[Rakhine State]], [[Myanmar]], an area controlled by the [[Arakan Army]]. [https://apnews.com/article/army-airstrike-private-schools-kyauktaw-rakhine-27430f83358928bb721bfcce698ade71 (AP)]
*[[Turkey–Islamic State conflict]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[General Directorate of Security (Turkey)|police]] arrest 161 people suspected of being members of the [[Islamic State]] (IS) over the last week and seize [[Criminal possession of a weapon|unlicensed weapons]] and IS documents in raids in 38 [[Provinces of Turkey|provinces]], including [[Istanbul]] and [[Ankara]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-islamic-state-arrests-bd38ed9d3cf8410e05537ce7b6b61f79 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Norges Bank]] removes [[Mining in France|French mining]] company [[Eramet]] from [[Norway]]'s [[Government Pension Fund of Norway|sovereign wealth fund]], citing risks of human rights abuses and [[Environmental impact of mining|environmental damage]] linked to a [[Nickel mining in Indonesia|nickel mining]] project in [[Halmahera]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2025/09/1274601/worlds-biggest-wealth-fund-drops-eramet-over-indonesia-nickel-mine (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 23 people are killed while five others are reported missing following days of flash floods and landslides in [[Bali]] and [[East Nusa Tenggara]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/12/rescuers-search-for-missing-people-as-deadly-indonesia-floods-recede (Al Jazeera]
*[[2025 Hassan district truck accident]]
**At least nine people are killed and 23 others are injured, including several critically and the driver, when a truck rams into people celebrating the [[Ganesh Chaturthi]] [[Hinduism|Hindu]] festival in [[Hassan district]], [[Karnataka]], [[India]]. [https://www.news18.com/india/five-dead-over-20-injured-as-truck-rams-into-ganesh-procession-in-karnatakas-hassan-ws-l-9568765.html (News18)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hubballi/9-dead-22-injured-as-truck-ploughs-into-ganpati-procession-in-karnatakas-hassan/articleshow/123862150.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*A [[ski lift]] accident on [[Mount Elbrus]] in [[Russia]] kills two people and injures nine others. [https://apnews.com/video/people-stranded-in-chairs-after-deadly-ski-lift-accident-on-mount-elbrus-europes-highest-mountain-fb485ed7bbca4efa8c8191f745832338 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], [[Eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly]]
**In a 142–10 vote with 12 abstentions, the [[UN General Assembly]] adopts the [[July 2025 Conference on the Implementation of the Two-State Solution#New York Declaration|New York Declaration]], calling for a [[ceasefire]] in the [[Gaza war]], the release of [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]], the disarmament of [[Hamas]], and renewed momentum toward a [[two-state solution]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/12/un-general-assembly-to-back-hamas-free-government-for-palestine (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Kosovo–United States relations]], [[North Kosovo crisis (2022–2025)|North Kosovo crisis]]
**The [[United States]] suspends its planned negotiations with [[Kosovo]], citing [[Second cabinet of Albin Kurti|caretaker government]] actions that it says have increased tensions and instability in [[Balkans|the region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-suspends-dialogue-with-kosovo-says-government-moves-stoke-instability-2025-09-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Charlie Kirk]]
**A 22-year-old is arrested as a suspect in the killing of [[Politics of the United States|American political]] commentator [[Charlie Kirk]] two days ago. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/charlie-kirk-shot-utah-death-09-12-25 (CNN)]
*[[Costa Rica]]n [[Public Force of Costa Rica|police]] arrest four suspects in the killing of exiled [[Nicaraguans|Nicaraguan]] former [[Nicaraguan Armed Forces|military]] officer Roberto Samcam near [[San José, Costa Rica|San José]] in June. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rican-police-arrest-4-killing-nicaraguan-opposition-figure-2025-09-12/ (Reuters)]
*The [[South Africa]]n [[High Court of South Africa|high court]] reopens an [[inquest]] into the 1977 death in [[South African Police|police]] custody of [[Internal resistance to apartheid|anti-apartheid]] leader [[Steve Biko]] to determine possible [[Crime in South Africa|crimes]] committed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-africa-reopens-inquest-into-1977-death-anti-apartheid-leader-steve-biko-2025-09-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Indian vice presidential election]]
**[[C. P. Radhakrishnan]] is sworn in as the 15th [[vice president of India|vice president]] of [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/after-resignation-of-former-vice-president-jagdeep-dhankar-nda-pick-chandrapuram-ponnusamy-radhakrishnan-takes-oath-as-vice-president-at-rashtrapati-b-9262659 (NDTV)]
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**The [[House of Representatives (Nepal)|House of Representatives]] is dissolved and [[Sushila Karki]] is appointed [[Provisional government|interim]] [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]] of [[Nepal]], making her the first woman to head [[Government of Nepal|Nepal's government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-sushila-karki-interim-government-aad7af5ddfb56b7484fa9db591297c9e (AP)] [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/nepal-protest-live-updates-interim-government-gen-z-trend-social-media-ban-news-2786037-2025-09-12 (''India Today'')]
